PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_BuildingCommon
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all instances of IfcBuilding

PropertyDef.Name: MainFireUse
PropertyDef.Definition: Main fire use for the building which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

PropertyDef.Name: AncillaryFireUse
PropertyDef.Definition: Ancillary fire use for the building which is assigned from the fire use classification table as given by the relevant national building code.

PropertyDef.Name: SprinklerProtection
PropertyDef.Definition: Indication whether this object is sprinkler protected (true) or not (false).

PropertyDef.Name: SprinklerProtectionAutomatic
PropertyDef.Definition: Indication whether this object has an automatic sprinkler protection (true) or not (false). It should only be given, if the property "SprinklerProtection" is set to TRUE.

PropertyDef.Name: OccupancyType
PropertyDef.Definition: Occupancy type for this object. It is defined according to the presiding national building code.
